answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. By the vine of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The beacon is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wharf. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
